boundary.message: The sea is too cold and too wide out there. You turn back to the rock.

content.outro: The boat pushes off from the jetty, and the chapel on the rock falls away behind you.
content.premise: A chapel stands on a rock in the sea, its yard walled against the wind. The boat that takes you off the rock waits at the end of the jetty, and the only way to the jetty is the old broken wall-walk, leapt gap by gap.
content.theme: A walled chapel yard with standing stones, a broken wall-walk over a flooded cistern, and a plank jetty out into the open sea.
content.title: Two Ways Off the Map
